name: Local Data 23
definition: Contains text fields in the local language.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: The language code conforming to ISO 639-1 that identifies the language in which the fields are expressed in this component.

EncodingFormat.name: Encoding Format
EncodingFormat.definition: Data encoding format for local data.

MailingAddress.name: Mailing Address
MailingAddress.definition: For cases where the card was not received, contains the local language equivalent of where the card was mailed to.

MailingAddressUnstructured.name: Mailing Address Unstructured
MailingAddressUnstructured.definition: For cases where the card was not received, contains the local language equivalent of the Unstructured mailing address where the card was mailed to.

MailedFromPostalCode.name: Mailed From Postal Code
MailedFromPostalCode.definition: For cases where the card was not received, contains the local language equivalent of the postal code where the card was mailed from.

CardholderName.name: Cardholder Name
CardholderName.definition: Local language equivalent of the Cardholder name.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information relevant for the settlement report.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
